وَأَصْلِحْ لِي آخِرَتِي الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَادِي، وَاجْعَلِ الحَيَاةَ زِيَادَةً لِي فِي كُلِّ خَيْرٍ وَاجْعَلِ المَوْتَ رَاحَةً لِي مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ * اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ خَيْرَ عُمْرِي آخِرَهُ وَخَيْرَ عَمَلِي خَوَاتِمَهُ وَخَيْرَ أَيَّامِي يَوْمَ أَلْقَاكَ فِيهِ * اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِيشَةً هَنِيَّةً وَمِيتَةً سَوِيَّةً وَمَرَدًّا غَيْرَ مُخْزٍ وَلاَ فَاضِحٍ * اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ المَسْأَلةِ وَخَيْرَ الدُّعَاءِ وَخَيْرَ النَّجَاحِ وَخَيْرَ العِلْمِ وَخَيْرَ العَمَلِ وَخَيْرَ الثَّوَابِ وَخَيْرَ الحَيَاةِ وَخيْرَ المَمَاتِ وَثَبِّتْنِي وَثَقِّلْ مَوَازِينِي وَحَقِّقْ إِيمَانِي وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتِي وَتَقَبَّلْ صَلاَتِي وَاغْفِرْ خَطِيئَاتِي وَأَسْأَلُكَ العُلَا مِنَ الجَنَّةِ * اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مُوجِبَاتِ رَحْمَتِكَ وَعَزَائِمِ مَغْفِرَتِكَ وَالسَّلاَمَةَ مِنْ كُلِّ إِثْمٍ وَالغَنِيمَةَ مِنْ كُلِّ بِرٍّ وَالفَوْزَ بِالجَنَّةِ وَالنَّجَاةَ مِنَ النَّارِ * اللَّهُمَّ أَحْسِنْ عَاقِبَتَنَا فِي الأُمُورِ كُلِّهَا، وَأجِرْنَا مِنْ خِزْيِ الدُّنْيَا وَعَذَابِ الآخِرَةِ * اللَّهُمَّ اقْسِمْ لَنَا مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ مَاتَحُولُ بِهِ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ مَعْصِيَتِكَ وَمِنْ طَاعَتِكَ مَاتُبَلِّغُنَا بِهَا جَنَّتَكَ وَمِنَ اليَقِينِ مَاتُهَوِّنُ بِهِ عَلَيْنَا مَصَائِبَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَتِّعْنَا بِأَسْمَاعِنَا وَأَبْصَارِنَا وَقُوَّتِنَا مَاأَحْيَيْتَنَا وَاجْعَلْهُ الوَارِثَ مِنَّا وَاجْعَلْ ثَأْرَنَا عَلَى مَنْ ظَلَمَنَا وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى مَنْ عَادَانَا وَلاَ تجْعَلْ مُصِيبَتَنَا فِي دِينِنَا وَلاَ تَجْعَلِ الدُّنْيَا أَكْبَرَ هَمِّنَا وَلَا مَبْلَغَ عِلْمِنَا وَلاَ تُسَلِّطْ عَلَيْنَا مَنْ لَا يَرْحَمُنَا * اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَدَعْ لَنَا pledge1_description: I commit to acting with complete integrity and transparency in all reports I submit and will not exploit the system for personal gain or illicit benefits.
pledge2_description: I confirm that I am not an employee or worker in the ministry, municipality, or affiliated with those engaged in monitoring violations, inspections, or related tasks, nor am I related by the first degree (spouse, in-law, or close relative) to any of these individuals.
pledge3_description: I commit to not fabricating any malicious violations with the intent of submitting false reports to obtain a reward or for any other purpose, and I accept full legal responsibility if this is discovered.
pledge4_description: I commit to submitting accurate and reliable reports on violations and understand that I am not entitled to claim a reward if the reported violation has been previously reported.
pledge5_description: I commit to adhering to the competency standards set by the ministry and understand that the ministry reserves the right to suspend my account on the Certified Observer platform if these standards are not met.
pledge6_description: I commit to fully cooperating with the relevant authorities within the ministry by providing the necessary information and facilitating the verification of reports.
pledge7_description: I commit to not exploiting the system for unearned financial gains or to influence the decisions of the relevant authorities in any way.
pledge8_description: I accept full legal responsibility for any false reports or inaccurate information I submit through the platform.
pledge9_description: I commit to not claiming any reward until the violation has been confirmed and the penalty has been fully paid by the violator. I understand that the reward amount does not exceed 25% of the violation's value.
pledge10_description: I acknowledge that if I report a violation and the violator corrects it before the inspector arrives to verify it, I am not entitled to claim a reward.
pledge11_description: I commit to maintaining the confidentiality of all information I handle and not disclosing it to any unauthorized party.
pledge12_description: I commit to adhering to all laws and regulations related to my role as a Certified Observer and understand that the ministry reserves the right to take any legal action against me in case of violation.
pledge13_description: I commit to continuously updating my knowledge regarding the laws, regulations, and procedures approved by the ministry to ensure the submission of accurate and reliable reports.
pledge14_description: I commit to reviewing the reports I submit to ensure they are free from errors or inaccuracies. I understand that submitting incorrect reports may result in my account being suspended.
pledge15_description: I commit to complying with all terms and procedures set by the ministry for obtaining the reward, and I understand that non-compliance with these terms may result in the loss of my right to claim the reward.
